| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Smallest wavelength** `wavelength` | 4 | 2 to 32 px | The wavelength of the finest scale. |
| **Scales** `scales` | 3 | 1 to 5 | How many wavelengths the bank holds. |
| **Scale factor** `factor` | 2 | 1.2 to 3 | Each scale has this many times the wavelength of the one before. |
| **Orientations** `orientations` | 4 | 1 to 12 | How many angles the bank holds, spread evenly from 0 to 180 degrees. |
| **Bandwidth** `bandwidth` | 1 | 0.5 to 3 octaves | The frequency bandwidth of each filter. It sets sigma from the wavelength. |
| **Aspect ratio** `aspect` | 1 | 0.2 to 5 | Sigma along the wave divided by sigma along the stripes, as in the Gabor filter. |
| **Output** `output` | Largest magnitude | Largest magnitude, Mean magnitude, Angle of the strongest filter | How the responses of the bank become one value per pixel. |
| **Output mapping** `outputMapping` | Stretch to full range | Absolute value, Offset by 128, Stretch to full range, Clip to 0 to 255 | How signed results, such as gradients, become 8-bit pixel values. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect 101 (default) | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | Brightness only | RGB, Brightness only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
